lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Nilda, Jorge here. How's your Wednesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. My knees have been bothering me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Only 2 days. Water just doesn't do it for me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you have a water bottle you like?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes. I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know, honestly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've already started.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the soda swap. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I started leaving the water bottle on the table.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really like my Coke with lunch.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Walking hurts my knees, so why bother.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On one hand, letting go of the Coke makes it really hard. On the other hand, you still want to make this work.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you keep soda in the house?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I just didn't feel like it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you wants this, and part of you is just worn out.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I swap soda for water on 5 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, being around for my family is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll eat a bigger lunch so I'm not starving at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 2 out of 5 days, the hard part was letting go of the Coke, and next week you're going to swap soda for water on 5 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

flags.reason: Participant voiced strong motivation (fear of cancer returning); coach deflected to autonomy at line 27 instead of exploring it.
Coach tells participant what the goal is really about, pushing a frame rather than eliciting her own reasons.
Participant said walking hurts her knees and 'why bother'; coach moved on without exploring the pain or discouragement.

score.summary: Jorge kept a structured call with a clear agenda, goal review, barrier planning, summary, and next contact. He missed several strong change-talk moments and used some persuading and deflection, and did not explore the knee pain that discouraged Nilda.
strengths: Line 3: opened by checking what Nilda wanted to cover, which set the agenda collaboratively.
Line 13 and 33: complex reflections captured her ambivalence and her motivation to be well for her family.
Line 57: summarized the goal and barriers clearly and checked for anything missed.
coaching_tips: Line 26: when she said 'I don't want the cancer back,' reflect that meaning before moving on instead of shifting to autonomy at line 27.
Line 28: swap the 'getting your life back' framing for an open question about what matters most to her.
Line 37: explore the knee pain and her 'why bother' feeling before setting the next goal; ask what would make walking feel possible.
Line 19 and 44: replace closed questions like 'Do you think 5 days is realistic?' with open ones to draw out her own reasoning.
